adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler, the decrypted `keys` payload is obtained via `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...))` and then written directly to `prisma.credential.update/create` as `key: keys` with no validation against any app-specific credential schema (only `userId/appSlug/keys` string are validated by zod). This means structurally invalid-but-JSON data can be persisted and would only fail later when services assume a specific credential shape.
